messages.author: 12a8430c1bf3f70b
messages.subject: Re: Map
parts:
Kostas,
Firstly you'll need a suitable map, I'm guessing that the "Administrative Areas" level 2 data from
http://www.diva-gis.org/gdata
will do the trick.  i.e. go to the above and grab the zip of the shapefiles... unzip and you'll see there are three sets,
GRC_adm0, GRC_adm1, GRC_adm
where 0 is just the country outline, 1 and 2 are internal administration levels - I suspect you want 2...

If you want to look at the shape file, try simply...

# skipping using ggplot2 for the moment...
libary(maptools)
g1 <- readShapePoly('GRC_adm2')
# plain black and white boundaries
plot(g1)

# but what are the administrative "shapes" in there?
str(g1@data)
g1@data

After that you need to be more clear about what data you have and what you want to do! :-) - as Roman says... "What is the question?"

Sean
